tasks.title: Implement the envlint CLI entry point

acceptance_criteria.text: `bin/envlint.mjs` exists with a `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang and `node --check bin/envlint.mjs` exits 0 (covers: REQ-21)
`envlint --schema <schema.json> <envfile>` reads both files from argv; `--schema=x` and a schema after the env file also work (TS-REQ-schema-position) (covers: REQ-8)
a `.env` in the working directory is never read (TS-NOGO-01) (covers: REQ-9)
usage errors (no args, `--schema` with no value, no env file, two env files, unknown option) exit 2 with `envlint:` and `usage:` on stderr (TS-ERR-USAGE) (covers: REQ-21)
findings and parse problems print one stdout line each, `<envfile>:<line>: <key>: <message>` (TS-ERR-FINDINGS) (covers: REQ-2)
exit 1 when anything is printed, exit 0 with empty stdout when clean (TS-REQ-clean) (covers: REQ-3)
stdout and stderr carry no ANSI escapes and the CLI never reads stdin (TS-INV-03) (covers: REQ-25)

acceptance_criteria: `node --test test/cli.test.mjs` passes, driving the binary with `spawnSync` over temp-dir fixtures

tasks.title: Harden the CLI edges with end-to-end fixture tests

acceptance_criteria.text: a missing env file or missing schema exits 2 with `envlint: cannot read <path>`, no stack trace (TS-ERR-IO) (covers: REQ-4)
a schema that is a directory, not valid JSON, or fails `checkSchema` exits 2 with `envlint:` on stderr (TS-ERR-IO, TS-ERR-SCHEMA) (covers: REQ-5)
an empty or comments-only env file exits 0 with no required keys and exits 1 naming the key when one is required (TS-REQ-empty-file) (covers: REQ-6)
a binary-garbage env file and a `null` schema never produce a stack trace (TS-INV-02) (covers: REQ-7)
the fixture directory is unchanged after every run (TS-INV-01) (covers: REQ-23)

acceptance_criteria: `node --test test/cli-edges.test.mjs` passes, and `npm test` runs more than 0 tests

bugs.repro: schema {"A":{"type":"int"}}, env 'A=\x1b[31mred'; node bin/envlint.mjs --schema s.json app.env
bugs.expected: stdout carries no ANSI escape sequences (UC-LintEnvFile INV-03)
bugs.actual: stdout 'app.env:1: A: expected int, got "\u001b[31mred"'; same for ESC in env key (PARSE_BAD_KEY, bin/envlint.mjs:54) and schema key (missing-key line)
bugs.fix_hint: escape control characters (\x1b, C0/C1) in printed text at the CLI print site; add a test with an ESC-bearing value
